text:
kevin: Can we add an audit log for kernel selection decisions when seq_len >= 1024? We just hit a regression where matmul was chosen for ~1536 and p95 CPU/GPU latency spiked.
sophia: We only emit the kernel name today. We should capture the reason code + candidate scores + hw_family + seq_len_bin so we can reproduce choices.
anna: Also include kv_cache_hit boolean and batch_size. Those change the opt path a lot.
mike: +1. We need sampling though — logging every request will blow our ingestion. Propose new env var `REDWOOD_KERNEL_AUDIT_SAMPLE` (default 0.01).
jin: Agree. Also need to ensure no PII/inputs. We can log token counts, seq_len, model_id hash, but not prompt text.
perf-bot: perf-alert: spike observed 2026-03-15T12:09Z. p95 for seq=1536 went 220ms -> 480ms. Correlated with kernel pick change on a100 nodes.
kevin: Example of a proposed audit log line: 
```json
{"ts":"2026-03-15T12:09:07Z","request_id":"r_abc123","kernel":"matmul","reason":"estimated_latency","scores":{"matmul":0.65,"fmha_fused":0.30,"fallback":0.05},"seq_len":1536,"seq_bin":"1024-2048","batch_size":1,"kv_cache_hit":false,"hw":"a100-80gb","lat_ms":470.2} 
```
sophia: Proposed fields: kernel, reason(enum), candidate_scores(map), seq_len, seq_bin, batch_size, kv_cache_hit, hw_family, model_hash, sample_rate, measured_latency_ms. Keep it flat.
mike: Env flags we can expose: `REDWOOD_KERNEL_AUDIT=1`, `REDWOOD_KERNEL_AUDIT_SAMPLE=0.01`, `REDWOOD_KERNEL_AUDIT_VERBOSE=1` (verbose emits candidate_scores).
jin: PR #3421 implements structured audit logs + reason enum (choices: "best_latency", "memory_constraint", "quantized_only", "fallback", "manual_override"). It also emits a metric `kernel_choice.count` with tags (kernel,reason,seq_bin,hw).
sophia: :thumbsup: Can we also emit `kernel_choice.latency_hist` for per-kernel latency distribution? That will help detect regressions faster.
kevin: Plan: land logging behind flags, canary at 0.1% sampling on hosted, wire metrics to datadog dashboard, then ramp if ingestion/cost is okay. I'll add an alert for unexpected shifts (e.g., matmul > 5% in 1024-2048).
mike: Make sure to add cost note in PR and an ops runbook entry about how to turn audit off if costs spike.
deploy-bot: Canary scheduled: deploy/eng-runtime#3421 -> group=canary-5pct start=2026-03-18T01:00:00Z
kevin: I'll own instrumentation + dashboard. I'll also add a small unit test that asserts we never log prompt text or full KV contents.
sophia: Thanks — once canary is green, roll to 25% and then to GA. Keep sample default low.
anna: One more ask: add an optpath_id in logs (short hash) so we can join runtime dumps with kernel choices when debugging.
kevin: Good call — adding `optpath_id`. I'll update PR #3421 today and request reviews.
mike: Thanks folks. If someone hits an immediate regression after the canary lands, ping #incidents and tag me.
jin: Noted.
perf-bot: scheduled perf check: 2026-03-18T02:00Z after canary warm-up.
kevin: I'll post the dashboard link here when ready.
